about: Open-source accounting software for small businesses, an alternative to QuickBooks and Xero.

prs.title: Tax rate picker can be searched
prs.broken: Typing in a line's tax rate field emptied the list, because the search looked at fields tax rates do not have.
prs.changed: The search now matches the tax rate's name and code, ignoring case.
prs.matters: Users with many tax rates can find the right one by typing.
